audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Mordekaiser 6 of 7 stages while Yasuo wins 52.15% over 1327 games — flagged in packet.defects — and it disagreed with the already-audited mirror.
audit.why: The mirror (mordekaiser__yasuo) set both layers atomically to Yasuo / Mordekaiser / Mordekaiser / Skill / Mordekaiser / Yasuo / Yasuo. Champion names are side-agnostic, so my page must read identically or mirror-fix.js will overwrite it. Four rows differ: [1], [3], [5], [6].
audit.corrected: Proposed all four flips as one atomic group with both layers paired (phases[N].side + win[N]), plus matching ratings and rewrites of the two whys/why lines that would otherwise contradict the new side (whys[3], phases[3].why, whys[5], spikes[2].text).

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2] and whys[5] said Yasuo is still losing after his first item, contradicting the mirror's first-item row and the win rate.
audit.why: Blade of the Ruined King plus Grievous Wounds is the point the trade math turns: Indestructible stores damage dealt and taken into a shield he can consume as a heal, so chip feeds him and burst does not.
audit.corrected: Rewrote spikes[2].text and whys[5] around the BotRK + anti-heal spike and the burst-don't-chip rule for Indestructible.

audit.whatIsWrong: tldr, winCon and report[1] told the player to 'block his E' with Wind Wall. Death's Grasp carries no projectile flag — it is an area pull — so Wind Wall cannot block it. dosFull[2] ('Dodge his E pull') carried an unrelated Realm of Death line in its body.
audit.why: Nothing in Mordekaiser's kit is a projectile. Obliterate is a ground cone (the page's content.early half-knew this), Death's Grasp is an area pull at 700 range on 16/14/12/10/8s, and Realm of Death is a 650-range drag on 140/120/100s. Wind Wall's only use in this lane is against a third party, and the page told the player it was a core win condition.
audit.corrected: Rewrote tldr, winCon, report[1].t, dosFull[2].d, content.early and breakdown.cooldowns to state that no part of his kit is blockable and to key the plan to sidestepping Death's Grasp with real cooldown numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1] was titled 'Build MR' but its body was the generic Q-stacking trade line.
audit.why: The title's actual content — magic resist plus early Grievous Wounds against Indestructible — was nowhere in the do's block.
audit.corrected: Replaced dosFull[1].d with the MR + Executioner's Calling reason.

audit.why: Mordekaiser's Q carries a 'grounding' derived flag, but Riot's own description for Obliterate says only that he smashes the ground for damage, increased against a single target. Per the standing rule I trusted the description and wrote nothing claiming his Q grounds your dashes — the page correctly never claimed it either.
audit.corrected: No edit. Flag/description conflict recorded here so it is not 'discovered' and written in as fact on a later pass.
